name: Material
description: Material data-block to define the appearance of geometric objects for rendering

props.name: Surface Render Method
props.description: Controls the blending and the compatibility with certain features

items.name: Dithered
items.description: Allows for grayscale hashed transparency, and compatible with render passes and raytracing. Also known as deferred rendering.

items.name: Blended
items.description: Allows for colored transparency, but incompatible with render passes and raytracing. Also known as forward rendering.

props.name: Displacement Method
props.description: Method to use for the displacement

items.name: Bump Only
items.description: Bump mapping to simulate the appearance of displacement

items.name: Displacement Only
items.description: Use true displacement of surface only, requires fine subdivision

items.name: Displacement and Bump
items.description: Combination of true displacement and bump mapping for finer detail

props.name: Blend Mode
props.description: Blend Mode for Transparent Faces (Deprecated: use 'surface_render_method')

items.name: Opaque
items.description: Render surface without transparency

items.name: Alpha Clip
items.description: Use the alpha threshold to clip the visibility (binary visibility)

items.name: Alpha Hashed
items.description: Use noise to dither the binary visibility (works well with multi-samples)

items.name: Alpha Blend
items.description: Render polygon transparent, depending on alpha channel of the texture

props.name: Clip Threshold
props.description: A pixel is rendered only if its alpha value is above this threshold

props.name: Use Transparency Overlap
props.description: Render multiple transparent layers (may introduce transparency sorting problems)

props.name: Show Backface
props.description: Render multiple transparent layers (may introduce transparency sorting problems) (Deprecated: use 'use_tranparency_overlap')

props.name: Backface Culling
props.description: Use back face culling to hide the back side of faces

props.name: Shadow Backface Culling
props.description: Use back face culling when casting shadows

props.name: Light Probe Volume Backface Culling
props.description: Consider material single sided for light probe volume capture. Additionally helps rejecting probes inside the object to avoid light leaks.

props.name: Transparent Shadows
props.description: Use transparent shadows for this material if it contains a Transparent BSDF, disabling will render faster but not give accurate shadows

props.name: Raytrace Transmission
props.description: Use raytracing to determine transmitted color instead of using only light probes. This prevents the surface from contributing to the lighting of surfaces not using this setting.

props.name: Raytrace Transmission
props.description: Use raytracing to determine transmitted color instead of using only light probes. This prevents the surface from contributing to the lighting of surfaces not using this setting. Deprecated: use 'use_raytrace_refraction'.

props.name: Subsurface Translucency
props.description: Add translucency effect to subsurface (Deprecated)

props.name: Refraction Depth
props.description: Approximate the thickness of the object to compute two refraction events (0 is disabled) (Deprecated)

props.name: Thickness Mode
props.description: Approximation used to model the light interactions inside the object

items.name: Sphere
items.description: Approximate the object as a sphere whose diameter is equal to the thickness defined by the node tree

items.name: Slab
items.description: Approximate the object as an infinite slab of thickness defined by the node tree

props.name: Thickness From Shadow
props.description: Use the shadow maps from shadow casting lights to refine the thickness defined by the material node tree

props.name: Volume Intersection Method
props.description: Determines which inner part of the mesh will produce volumetric effect

items.name: Fast
items.description: Each face is considered as a medium interface. Gives correct results for manifold geometry that contains no inner parts.

items.name: Accurate
items.description: Faces are considered as medium interface only when they have different consecutive facing. Gives correct results as long as the max ray depth is not exceeded. Have significant memory overhead compared to the fast method.

props.name: Max Vertex Displacement
props.description: The max distance a vertex can be displaced. Displacements over this threshold may cause visibility issues.

props.name: Preview Render Type
props.description: Type of preview render

items.name: Flat
items.description: Flat XY plane

items.name: Sphere
items.description: Sphere

items.name: Cube
items.description: Cube

items.name: Hair
items.description: Hair strands

items.name: Shader Ball
items.description: Shader ball

items.name: Cloth
items.description: Cloth

items.name: Fluid
items.description: Fluid

props.name: Preview World
props.description: Use the current world background to light the preview render

props.name: Pass Index
props.description: Index number for the "Material Index" render pass

props.name: Node Tree
props.description: Node tree for node based materials

props.name: Use Nodes
props.description: Use shader nodes to render the material

deprecated.note: Unused but kept for compatibility reasons. Setting the property has no effect, and getting it always returns True.

props.name: Animation Data
props.description: Animation data for this data-block

props.name: Texture Slot Images
props.description: Texture images used for texture painting

props.name: Texture Slots
props.description: Texture slots defining the mapping and influence of textures

props.name: Active Paint Texture Index
props.description: Index of active texture paint slot

props.name: Clone Paint Texture Index
props.description: Index of clone texture paint slot

props.name: Diffuse Color
props.description: Diffuse color of the material

props.name: Specular Color
props.description: Specular color of the material

props.name: Roughness
props.description: Roughness of the material

props.name: Specular
props.description: How intense (bright) the specular reflection is

props.name: Metallic
props.description: Amount of mirror reflection for raytrace

props.name: Line Color
props.description: Line color used for Freestyle line rendering

props.name: Line Priority
props.description: The line color of a higher priority is used at material boundaries

props.name: Grease Pencil Settings
props.description: Grease Pencil color settings for material

props.name: Is Grease Pencil
props.description: True if this material has Grease Pencil data

props.name: Line Art Settings
props.description: Line Art settings for material

props.name: Cycles Material Settings
props.description: Cycles material settings
